name: Tests: what a change leaves behind
note: Where tests belong and what counts as a change nothing is watching. Edit it, or add your own pack, to match how your team works.

rules.name: A focused test hides the rest
A test is switched off
rules.good: fix it, or delete it and say why

rules.name: An assertion was removed from a test
rules.good: keep an assertion that checks the result

rules.name: Logic changed and no test did
rules.bad: 40 lines of logic, no test file in the commit
rules.good: a test that fails without the change

rules.name: Tests were deleted
rules.good: moved, or replaced by something that checks the same

rules.name: A test that passed before now fails
rules.bad: green at the base, red at the head

rules.name: A changed line nobody notices
rules.bad: the tests pass with the new line flipped

rules.name: A risky change can be undone without a test noticing
rules.bad: tests pass with the change put back as it was
rules.good: a test that fails when it is put back
